newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDESPar to sell Petrobras shrs May 23.
newsitem.headline: BNDESPar to sell Petrobras shrs May 23.

text.p: Brazil's BNDES Participacoes (BNDESPar) said it will begin offering 500 million preferred shares of state oil firm Petrobras at an auction on May 23.
The shares, representing 0.46 percent of Petrobras' total capital, are part of BNDESPar's portfolio, it said in a published statement.

The minimum price for the shares on offer will be the average market price before 1330 local/1630 GMT on the auction's date if it is equal to or higher than a basic price of 225.80 reais per 1,000 shares, it added.
If the average trading price is lower than the basic price, then the auction will be postponed until the next day and the days subsequently for a period of 10 days.
The auction, to be held on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange, will only take place if the average trading price is equal or higher than the basic price, the statement said.
The sell-off is "guaranteed" by 32 financial institutions which had committed themselves to buying specific share amounts each at the minimum price if no other buyers participated in the auction.
Banks and brokerages coordinating the sale include local banks Garantia, Primus, Bradesco, ING Barings, Merrill Lynch, Banco Bozano and Simonsen, among others.
